name: openbb_equity_revenue_geographic
description:
Revenue by geographic region for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.revenue_per_geography).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (fmp; default fmp).
By segment: openbb_equity_revenue_segment; another source: fmp_revenue_by_geography. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
